entities.summary: Alexander Kendrick is an American pastor, film writer, producer, director, and actor. He is best known for directing and starring in notable faith-based films, including Facing the Giants, War Room, Overcomer, Courageous, and Fireproof. He is one of two film directors to have 4 films receive an "A+" grade on CinemaScore.
